newsitem.title: ITALY: Creditors, Impianti reach accord on Italy's Belleli.
newsitem.headline: Creditors, Impianti reach accord on Italy's Belleli.

text.p: Creditor banks and executives of the Impianti group have reached preliminary accords on parts of a restructuring plan for insolvent Italian plant engineering group Belleli, an Industry Ministry statement said.

Under the plan, creditor banks will immediately transfer at least 70 billion lire to Impianti Holding, a new company whose capital is to be held by the creditors, to capitalise two new companies Belleli Energy and Belleli Offshore in Taranto and to cover losses of Belleli Spa.
The ministry said banks were also prepared to seek a further 30 billion lire among institutions to cover further losses.
In order for Belleli Energy and Belleli Offshore to resume production, lines of credit would also be opened from July 1 for the two companies, it said.
The agreement was reached after a meeting between Impianti management and 18 credit institutes at the Industry Ministry.
The Belleli parent company was put into the hands of court appointed administrators in November 1995 to enable it to restructure its operations in temporary protection from its creditors.
